question: A 38-year-old project manager is told by her boss that her team will need to work on an additional project in the coming week for a very important client. This frustrates the woman, who already feels that she works too many hours. Instead of discussing her feelings directly with her boss, the woman leaves a voice message for her boss the next day and deceitfully says she cannot come to work for the next week because of a family emergency. Which of the following psychological defense mechanisms is this individual demonstrating?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Frustration due to excessive workload" -> "Avoidance of direct confrontation with boss" -> "Deceitful behavior to avoid work" -> opc. Passive aggression -> 95%
CHAIN: "Feeling overwhelmed by work demands" -> "Inability to express emotions openly" -> "Fabricating a family emergency to avoid work" -> opd. Malingering -> 90%
analysis: The individual in the scenario is using a psychological defense mechanism to avoid confronting her boss directly about her frustrations. By creating a false family emergency to avoid work, she is demonstrating the defense mechanism of malingering, which involves feigning illness or other reasons to avoid responsibilities.
